title: Affine base change: pushforward of a quasi-coherent module along an affine morphism commutes with arbitrary base change
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be an affine morphism of schemes [pqf-def-affine-morphism], $g:S'\to S$ a morphism, $X'=X\times_SS'$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $g':X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to S'$, and $\mathcal F$ a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent]. (1) $f_*\mathcal F$ is quasi-coherent, and the base change map $g^*f_*\mathcal F\to f'_*(g')^*\mathcal F$ (adjoint [def-pc-module-pullback] to $f_*\mathcal F\to f_*g'_*(g')^*\mathcal F=g_*f'_*(g')^*\mathcal F$) is an isomorphism; over affine opens $\operatorname{Spec}R'\subseteq S'$ above $\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S$, with $f^{-1}(\operatorname{Spec}R)=\operatorname{Spec}B$ and $M=\mathcal F(\operatorname{Spec}B)$, it is the identification $R'\otimes_RM=(R'\otimes_RB)\otimes_BM$. (2) For $\mathcal F=\mathcal O_X$ it is an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_{S'}$-algebras $g^*f_*\mathcal O_X\cong f'_*\mathcal O_{X'}$ (the algebra structure on $g^*f_*\mathcal O_X$ induced through $g^*(\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal A)\cong g^*\mathcal A\otimes g^*\mathcal A$). (3) The base change maps are compatible with composition: for a further $h:S''\to S'$, the base change map for $g\circ h$ equals the composite of $h^*$ of the one for $g$ with the one for $h$ (applied to $f'$ and $(g')^*\mathcal F$), under $(g\circ h)^*=h^*g^*$.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 02KG (lemma-affine-base-change) and the base change diagram (equation-base-change-diagram) before it; (2) and (3) are not stated by Stacks: (2) is the affine-local formula of (1) for M = B, which is a ring isomorphism R' (x)_R B = R' (x)_R B; (3) follows from the same local formula
